These models represent our most advanced and intelligent systems to date, improving from our experience in building QwQ and Qwen2.5. sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B - Jetson AI Lab
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 9B is a dense vision-language model in the Qwen3.5 family aimed at stronger reasoning, visual understanding, and agentic behavior on Jetson. This entry uses a W4A16 checkpoint on Jetson Orin and an NVFP4 checkpoint on Jetson Thor.

sources.title: Qwen: Qwen3.5-9B - AI Model Details & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B, a multimodal foundation model from qwen, demonstrates a strong overall reliability with an 83% success rate across benchmarks, indicating consistent operational stability. However, its speed performance is a notable area for improvement, ranking in the 10th percentile, suggesting longer response times compared to peers.
